provenance.what: Pointer events at pane-local cells, the child's reporting level and encoding, and the exact report bytes the child reads.
provenance.why: The embedded terminal dropped every pointer event; a child that asked for mouse tracking (vim, htop, less, the dashboard of another dashboard) got nothing.
provenance.oracle: prompt_toolkit.key_binding.bindings.mouse tables xterm_sgr_mouse_events, typical_mouse_events and urxvt_mouse_events decode each report back to button, event type and modifiers; the decoded event must equal the fixture event.
